question: What is the tone of the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage analyzes the importance of **public transportation** in urban sustainability by explaining its benefits like reducing emissions, easing mobility, and boosting economic efficiency. (विश्लेषणात्मक)
 
• It is also **supportive** in tone because it highlights the positive impacts of investing in and planning sustainable transport systems. (समर्थनकारी)
 
• While challenges like funding and equity are acknowledged, the overall approach is constructive and encouraging.
 
• Thus, the tone of the passage is best described as **Analytical and supportive**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2) Analytical and supportive**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Skeptical (संदेहपूर्ण)** – A skeptical tone would doubt the effectiveness of public transport.

 **Example:** “Public transport rarely solves traffic issues” – This is not reflected in the passage.
 
• **Option 3: Neutral (तटस्थ)** – A neutral tone would present facts without support or criticism.

 **Example:** Simply stating data about transport without expressing benefits.
 
• **Option 4: Aggressive (आक्रामक)** – An aggressive tone would harshly criticize the lack of transport or blame authorities.

 **Example:** “The government has failed miserably in transport planning” – This is not the tone of the passage.
